subject: Re: Kickoff: multilingual NMT representation analysis at scale
body: Status. Repro milestone: done — Quentin regenerated the release plots from model_scores.csv and finetuned_model_scores.csv, and our reading matches the paper: encoder representations cluster by linguistic family, and the clustering sharpens with depth. Extension to the production model: the SVCCA pipeline now runs on our checkpoints; on the 12-pair pilot grid, high-resource pairs show layer-5 encoder similarity above 0.86 within family, and Nikhil's probe finetunes reproduce the expected asymmetry — finetuning a high-resource pair barely moves related-pair representations, while low-resource pairs shift broadly (matching the relative-BLEU-change pattern in the release data). Risks: (1) full activation dumps for the July grid project to ~38 TB — Csilla is negotiating retention with Corpus (dump, compute SVCCA, delete within 72 h); (2) checkpoint selection — production checkpoints aren't evenly spaced like the release data, which complicates the across-checkpoint axis. — Vera
